--[[
	MeshFrames  -  mesh sequence playback for Part visuals (a flipbook of MeshParts).

	A MeshFrames Folder under the item holds frames named 1..N: MeshParts, or Parts with a SpecialMesh.
	Each frame carries a mesh id and, optionally, a texture id. The visual steps through them on the
	particle's own clock (pData._effectiveElapsed, so Timescale / Pause / FreezeTime / reverse apply);
	the Size graph keeps driving the visual's size and every frame is fitted into that box.

	Two routes, chosen by the visual:
	  MeshPart          MeshPart:ApplyMesh with the frame instance (the only runtime-legal mesh change).
	                    ApplyMesh copies TextureID with the mesh, so a textured frame wins and an untextured
	                    frame gets the visual's current texture written back after the swap. The frame
	                    instances must exist in the place; the folder under the item guarantees that.
	  Part + SpecialMesh  SpecialMesh.MeshId and the frame's texture are written together: the texture goes
	                    to the RenderTemplate's first Decal / Texture (so a Neon part keeps glowing), else to
	                    SpecialMesh.TextureId. DecalLayers leaves that first decal's flipbook to this module.
	data.MeshFramesTextured (any frame with a texture) tells Emit to skip the legacy texture flipbook.

	Config attributes: MeshFrameMode ("None" / OneShot / Loop / PingPong), MeshFrameFramerate
	(NumberRange), MeshFrameStartRandom, MeshFrameReverse.

	Mutates the clone (Emit) or the LIVE RT (Animate: a backup of the mesh and texture taken at attach,
	restore() puts it back on finish and cancel). refresh() re-reads the settings per AnimateLoop cycle.
	The frame task allocates nothing per tick.
]]

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local MeshFrames = {}

local MODES = { OneShot = true, Loop = true, PingPong = true }
local preloadedCount = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local warnedUnsupported = false

-- Shared with the plugin's Mesh Frames panel and inventory insert so all three agree on what a frame is.
local function isFrame(inst)
	return inst:IsA("MeshPart") or (inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil)
end
MeshFrames.isFrame = isFrame

local function firstDecal(part)
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then return child end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Mesh id and texture id a frame carries ("" when untextured).
local function frameIds(frame)
	if frame:IsA("MeshPart") then return frame.MeshId, frame.TextureID end
	local mesh = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
	local decal = firstDecal(frame)
	local texture = (decal and decal.Texture ~= "" and decal.Texture) or mesh.TextureId
	return mesh.MeshId, texture
end

-- Frames under the folder sorted by numeric name; preloaded whenever the count changes.
function MeshFrames.readFrames(folder)
	local frames = {}
	if not folder then return frames end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if isFrame(child) then table.insert(frames, child) end
	end
	table.sort(frames, function(a, b)
		return (tonumber(a.Name) or 0) < (tonumber(b.Name) or 0)
	end)
	if #frames > 0 and preloadedCount[folder] ~= #frames then
		preloadedCount[folder] = #frames
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function() ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(frames) end)
		end)
	end
	return frames
end

-- GetData hook.
function MeshFrames.readInto(data, item, config)
	data.MeshFrames = MeshFrames.readFrames(item:FindFirstChild("MeshFrames"))
	data.MeshFrameMeshIds = {}
	data.MeshFrameTextures = {}
	data.MeshFramesTextured = false
	for index, frame in ipairs(data.MeshFrames) do
		local meshId, texture = frameIds(frame)
		data.MeshFrameMeshIds[index] = meshId
		data.MeshFrameTextures[index] = texture
		if texture ~= "" then data.MeshFramesTextured = true end
	end
	local mode = config:GetAttribute("MeshFrameMode")
	if typeof(mode) == "EnumItem" then mode = mode.Name end
	data.MeshFrameMode = MODES[mode] and mode or "None"
	data.MeshFrameFramerate = config:GetAttribute("MeshFrameFramerate") or NumberRange.new(24)
	data.MeshFrameStartRandom = config:GetAttribute("MeshFrameStartRandom") == true
	data.MeshFrameReverse = config:GetAttribute("MeshFrameReverse") == true
end

local function isActive(data)
	return data.MeshFrames ~= nil and #data.MeshFrames > 0 and data.MeshFrameMode ~= "None"
end

local function buildState(data, visualPart)
	local framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.MeshFrameFramerate)
	local state = MeshFlipMod.layerState(visualPart, data.MeshFrames, data.MeshFrameMode, framerate,
		data.MeshFrameStartRandom, data.MeshFrameReverse)
	state.meshIds = data.MeshFrameMeshIds
	state.textures = data.MeshFrameTextures
	return state
end

-- Where the SpecialMesh route writes the frame texture: the first decal, else the mesh itself.
local function textureSlot(visualPart, specialMesh)
	local decal = firstDecal(visualPart)
	if decal then return decal, "Texture" end
	return specialMesh, "TextureId"
end

local function applyFrame(state, visual, index)
	pcall(function()
		if state.specialMesh then
			state.specialMesh.MeshId = state.meshIds[index]
			local texture = state.textures[index]
			if texture ~= "" then state.textureTarget[state.textureProp] = texture end
			return
		end
		local frame = state.frames[index]
		local currentTexture = visual.TextureID
		visual:ApplyMesh(frame)
		if frame.TextureID == "" and currentTexture ~= "" then visual.TextureID = currentTexture end
	end)
end

-- Steps the sequence until the particle is reclaimed (or, for clones, the wall-clock cap).
local function runTask(pData, state, lifetime, liveSource)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	task.spawn(function()
		while not state.stopped do
			local visual = pData.VisualPart
			if not visual or not visual.Parent then break end
			if pData._nestedAlive and not pData._nestedAlive[1] then break end
			if not liveSource and os.clock() - startTime > lifetime * 4 then break end
			local elapsed = pData._effectiveElapsed or (os.clock() - startTime)
			local frameIndex = MeshFlipMod.frameIndex(state, elapsed, pData.LifeTime or lifetime)
			if frameIndex ~= state.lastFrame then
				state.lastFrame = frameIndex
				applyFrame(state, visual, frameIndex)
			end
			task.wait()
		end
		if state.stopped or liveSource or state.mode == "Loop" or state.mode == "PingPong" then return end
		local visual = pData.VisualPart
		if visual and visual.Parent then applyFrame(state, visual, MeshFlipMod.finalFrame(state)) end
	end)
end

-- A pooled clone may still carry the previous emit's last frame: put the template's mesh back.
local function resetToTemplate(visualPart, specialMesh, rt)
	if not rt then return end
	if specialMesh then
		local rtMesh = rt:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
		if rtMesh and specialMesh.MeshId ~= rtMesh.MeshId then pcall(function() specialMesh.MeshId = rtMesh.MeshId end) end
	elseif rt:IsA("MeshPart") and visualPart.MeshId ~= rt.MeshId then
		pcall(function() visualPart:ApplyMesh(rt) end)
	end
end

-- Bind the sequence to the visual: show the start frame now, then step it on the particle's clock.
-- liveSource = Animate on the RT itself: keep a backup for restore() and never time-cap the task.
function MeshFrames.attach(pData, data, visualPart, lifetime, liveSource)
	pData.MeshFrames = nil
	local active = isActive(data)
	local specialMesh = (not visualPart:IsA("MeshPart")) and visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") or nil
	if not visualPart:IsA("MeshPart") and not specialMesh then
		if active and not warnedUnsupported then
			warnedUnsupported = true
			Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] Mesh Frames need a MeshPart or a Part with a SpecialMesh as RenderTemplate; %s is a %s."):format(
				visualPart:GetFullName(), visualPart.ClassName))
		end
		return
	end
	if not active then
		if not liveSource then resetToTemplate(visualPart, specialMesh, data.RenderTemplate) end
		return
	end
	local state = buildState(data, visualPart)
	if specialMesh then
		state.specialMesh = specialMesh
		state.textureTarget, state.textureProp = textureSlot(visualPart, specialMesh)
	end
	if liveSource then
		if specialMesh then
			state.backup = { meshId = specialMesh.MeshId, texture = state.textureTarget[state.textureProp] }
		else
			local backup = visualPart:Clone()
			for _, child in ipairs(backup:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
			backup.Name = "_MeshFrameBackup"
			backup.Archivable = false
			backup.Parent = VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
			state.backup = backup
		end
	end
	pData.MeshFrames = state
	runTask(pData, state, lifetime, liveSource)
end

-- Animate finish / cancel: stop stepping and put the RT's own mesh (and texture) back.
function MeshFrames.restore(pData)
	local state = pData.MeshFrames
	if not state then return end
	state.stopped = true
	local backup = state.backup
	if not backup then return end
	state.backup = nil
	local visual = pData.VisualPart
	if state.specialMesh then
		pcall(function()
			state.specialMesh.MeshId = backup.meshId
			state.textureTarget[state.textureProp] = backup.texture
		end)
		return
	end
	if visual and visual.Parent then pcall(function() visual:ApplyMesh(backup) end) end
	pcall(function() backup:Destroy() end)
end

-- AnimateLoop cycle: re-read the settings and frames for the next cycle.
function MeshFrames.refresh(pData, freshData)
	local state = pData.MeshFrames
	if not state or not freshData or not isActive(freshData) then return end
	local fresh = buildState(freshData, state.target)
	state.frames, state.n, state.mode = fresh.frames, fresh.n, fresh.mode
	state.meshIds, state.textures = fresh.meshIds, fresh.textures
	state.frameDelay, state.startOffset, state.reverse = fresh.frameDelay, fresh.startOffset, fresh.reverse
	state.lastFrame = -1
end

return MeshFrames

--[[
	NativeMotion  -  the path of one particle of a native ParticleEmitter, as the engine moves it.
	Every step the engine adds Acceleration to the particle's velocity and scales the whole
	velocity by 2 ^ (-Drag * dt). Drag is therefore a half-life (after 1 / Drag seconds half the
	speed is left), and it acts on Acceleration's share too: a falling particle approaches a
	terminal velocity. With k = ln(2) * Drag that is v' = a - k v, whose solution is
	  offset(t) = v0 * velocityShare + a * accelerationShare
	  velocityShare     = (1 - e^(-k t)) / k
	  accelerationShare = (t - velocityShare) / k
	and, for k = 0, velocityShare = t and accelerationShare = t^2 / 2.
	  NativeMotion.shares(drag, t) -> velocityShare, accelerationShare
	Plain numbers; the caller multiplies its own vectors. A negative Drag grows the speed.
	NOT the plugin's own particles: theirs is the same half-life on the Speed graph alone,
	Acceleration undragged (Part/DragModel).
	Consumer: Modules/MotionPreview (drawForPE).
]]

local NativeMotion = {}

local LN2 = math.log(2)
-- Below this k * t the drag terms cancel to nothing in floating point: the drag-free path is exact enough.
local NO_DRAG = 1e-6

function NativeMotion.shares(drag, t)
	local k = LN2 * drag
	if math.abs(k * t) < NO_DRAG then
		return t, t * t / 2
	end
	local velocityShare = (1 - math.exp(-k * t)) / k
	return velocityShare, (t - velocityShare) / k
end

return NativeMotion

--[[
	NestedEmit - source-walk dispatcher for nested transformed Part-Icles.

	Walks SOURCE RenderTemplate (never clones nested-source subtrees). Each
	transformed leaf fires via particle:EnableEmit with link=clonedRoot, which
	EmitPart's link branch consumes for both initial spawn pose and per-frame
	tracking. parentAlive cancels nested closures on parent pData reclaim.
]]

local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

local NestedEmit = {}

-- Nearest ancestor with a world frame (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Bone), stopping at the RT root.
local function nearestFrameAncestor(node, sourceRT)
	local cur = node.Parent
	while cur and cur ~= sourceRT do
		if cur:IsA("BasePart") or cur:IsA("Attachment") or cur:IsA("Model") then return cur end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return sourceRT
end

-- Walk source RT, fire each Transformed leaf. scaleNode (optional) is the parent-Model scale
-- chain node every leaf inherits as descCtx.ParentScale: a Model passes its own node, a
-- Part/Attachment forwards the node it inherited. _parentCloneMap forwards Pool's
-- source-to-clone map so nested Trail/Beam can rebind Attachment0/1.
-- _linkLocal is the leaf's parent-node offset from the RT root, so a leaf under a Model sub-part
-- spawns and tracks at that sub-part (LinkCF applies it to every link frame); nil at the root, which
-- keeps depth-1 children of a Part RT spawning at the clone itself. _sourceParentCF lets the spawn
-- rotation compose relative to that parent node instead of doubling the parent's world rotation.
-- decorate(node, descCtx), optional, runs last on every leaf's context: a Container hands each
-- leaf its drive record there. _containerDrive is forwarded to deeper leaves, so what a carried
-- item carries shares its record.
function NestedEmit.walk(particle, sourceRT, clonedRoot, parentAlive, emitCtx, scaleNode, decorate)
	if parentAlive and parentAlive[1] == false then return end
	local parentCloneMap = Pool._cloneMaps and Pool._cloneMaps[clonedRoot]
	-- Chain to the grandparent's map so a leaf resolves attachments authored one level up.
	-- Pool hits reuse the map, so the chain is refreshed rather than set once.
	local grandMap = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if parentCloneMap and grandMap and grandMap ~= parentCloneMap then
		local mt = getmetatable(parentCloneMap)
		if mt then mt.__index = grandMap else setmetatable(parentCloneMap, { __index = grandMap }) end
	end
	local leaves = {}
	local function visit(node)
		if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			leaves[#leaves + 1] = node
			return
		end
		for _, child in node:GetChildren() do visit(child) end
	end
	visit(sourceRT)
	if #leaves == 0 then return end
	local rootCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(sourceRT)
	local function fire(node)
		local descCtx = { ParentScale = scaleNode }
		local parentNode = nearestFrameAncestor(node, sourceRT)
		local parentCF = (parentNode == sourceRT) and rootCF or Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(parentNode)
		descCtx._sourceParentCF = parentCF
		if parentNode ~= sourceRT then descCtx._linkLocal = rootCF:ToObjectSpace(parentCF) end
		if emitCtx then
			descCtx.ChainCtx  = emitCtx.ChainCtx
			descCtx.EmitIndex = emitCtx.EmitIndex
			descCtx.EmitCount = emitCtx.EmitCount
			-- Forward the ghost play token so nested particles belong to the same play
			-- (PlayHandle:Disable / SetTimescale / GetParticles reach them too).
			descCtx._playToken = emitCtx._playToken
			descCtx._containerDrive = emitCtx._containerDrive
		end
		descCtx._parentAlive = parentAlive
		descCtx._parentCloneMap = parentCloneMap
		if decorate then decorate(node, descCtx) end
		particle:EnableEmit(node, clonedRoot, descCtx)
	end
	-- Attachment emitters first: EmitAttachment registers its visual in the map, so sibling
	-- Beams / Trails fired in the same walk bind their ends to the emitted attachment, and
	-- stock Beams / Trails in the parent copy are bound as each attachment registers.
	for _, node in ipairs(leaves) do
		if node:IsA("Attachment") then fire(node) end
	end
	for _, node in ipairs(leaves) do
		if not node:IsA("Attachment") then fire(node) end
	end
end


-- Clone-side parent for a nested visual: the parent's copyBare clone of the source's nearest
-- BasePart ancestor, else the parent clone root when it is a BasePart. nil when not nested-driven
-- or nothing suitable was cloned (rig parents build per-segment copies and keep no map).
-- Consumer: EmitAttachment (visual parent). Keeps emitted visuals inside the parent
-- clone instead of the source RenderTemplate, where a later copyBare would template them.
function NestedEmit.resolveCloneParent(sourceNode, link, emitCtx)
	if not emitCtx then return nil end
	local map = emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if map then
		local node = sourceNode.Parent
		while node and node ~= workspace do
			local clone = map[node]
			if clone then
				if clone:IsA("BasePart") then return clone end
				break
			end
			node = node.Parent
		end
	end
	if emitCtx._parentAlive and link and link:IsA("BasePart") then return link end
	return nil
end

return NestedEmit

--[[
	Orientation Mixin  -  per-frame rotation overlay for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Modes mirror ParticleOrientation: None, FacingCamera, FacingCameraWorldUp,
	VelocityParallel, VelocityPerpendicular. Composes as `orient * existingRotation`.
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3
local Y_AXIS = Vector3.yAxis
local X_AXIS = Vector3.xAxis
local DEFAULT_VEL = -Vector3.zAxis

function Particle:ApplyOrientation(pData, dt, camPos)
	local mode = pData.Orientation
	if not mode or mode == "None" then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	-- Use pre-overlay base CFrame; reading live would compound previous frame's compose into existingRot.
	local currentCF = pData._postUpdateCF or (isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame)

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; work in world space for the lookAt, convert back on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			currentCF = parentPart.CFrame * currentCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = currentCF.Position
	local existingRot = currentCF - pos

	local vel
	if pData._lastOrientPos then
		vel = (pos - pData._lastOrientPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-4)
	else
		vel = pData.BaseDirection or DEFAULT_VEL
	end
	pData._lastOrientPos = pos

	local orientRot
	if mode == "FacingCamera" then
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		if toCam.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, toCam.Unit)
	elseif mode == "FacingCameraWorldUp" then
		-- Yaw-only: flatten camera direction onto XZ so mesh rotates around world Y only.
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		local flat = Vector3.new(toCam.X, 0, toCam.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat.Unit, Y_AXIS)
	elseif mode == "VelocityParallel" then
		-- DirMode=Local already aligns via LocalCF; overlaying here would double-rotate.
		if pData.VelocityVectored then return end
		-- forward = velocity, roll tracks camera so broadside stays visible.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upHint = camPos and (camPos - pos) or Y_AXIS
		if upHint.Magnitude < EPS then upHint = Y_AXIS end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, vel.Unit, upHint.Unit)
	elseif mode == "VelocityPerpendicular" then
		-- up = velocity, forward fixed in world-horizontal plane.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upV = vel.Unit
		local fwd = upV:Cross(Y_AXIS)
		if fwd.Magnitude < EPS then fwd = upV:Cross(X_AXIS) end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, fwd.Unit, upV)
	else
		-- Warn once per pData on unknown Orientation so typos don't fail silently.
		if not pData._orientWarned then
			pData._orientWarned = true
			Log.warn("Part-Icles: unknown Orientation '" .. tostring(pData.Orientation) .. "' on emitted particle  -  falling back to identity.")
		end
		return
	end

	local newCF = CFrame.new(pos) * orientRot * existingRot

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

--[[
	PartConstants  -  lookup tables and helpers shared by Emit / Update / Transform.
	  DirectionVectors[NormalId] → (axis, multiplier) for CFrame component reads.
	  shapeFunctions[ParticleEmitterShape] → (offset, rotation, direction) per shape.
	  resolveLinkCFrame, composeRotation, applyPositionOffset  -  see per-function comments.
]]

local PartConstants = {}

-- Type-dispatched world CFrame: Bone→TransformedWorldCFrame (animated pose), Attachment→WorldCFrame,
-- Model→GetPivot, else .CFrame. Bone inherits Attachment, so its test must run first.
function PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if link:IsA("Bone") then return link.TransformedWorldCFrame end
	if link:IsA("Attachment") then return link.WorldCFrame end
	if link:IsA("Model") then return link:GetPivot() end
	return link.CFrame
end

-- Compounded scale factor of a nested particle's parent-Model CHAIN. `parentScale` is
-- `pData.ParentScale`, a linked list via `.Parent` (Model→Model→… ; Parts forward the same
-- node). Each node is { Owner = the Model's pData, ScaleMotion, ScaleRotation,
-- ScaleTextureLength, Parent }: the level's factor is the owner's `_ownScale`, published by
-- UpdateModel from its own timescaled step (so replay cycles and Timescale stay in sync), or
-- its Scale graph at its own elapsed time before the first step. nil → 1. GraphMod passed in
-- so PartConstants stays require-free. `gate`: nil = all levels (Size/visual); "motion" =
-- only levels with ScaleMotion; "rotation" = only levels with ScaleRotation.
function PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor(parentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, gate)
	local factor = 1
	local ps = parentScale
	while ps do
		local include = true
		if gate == "motion" then include = ps.ScaleMotion ~= false
		elseif gate == "rotation" then include = ps.ScaleRotation == true end
		if include then
			local owner = ps.Owner
			local levelF = owner and owner._ownScale
			if not levelF then
				if owner and owner._staticScale then
					levelF = owner._staticScale
				elseif owner and owner.Graphs and owner.Graphs.Scale then
					local pI = math.clamp((currentTime - owner.StartTime) / owner.LifeTime, 0, 1)
					levelF = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(pI, owner.Graphs.Scale, owner.Seeds.Scale)
				else
					levelF = 1
				end
			end
			factor = factor * math.max(0.001, levelF)
		end
		ps = ps.Parent
	end
	return factor
end

-- LocalABC entries are intrinsic Tait-Bryan Euler (body-frame composition, left-to-right).
-- Global (default) is the legacy Y*X*Z composition around fixed world axes; preserved so
-- existing saves don't shift visually on update. When the emission axis aligns with a
-- rotation axis, intrinsic ordering can no-op that axis on the launch direction  -  Global
-- gives the typical spread-cone behaviour.
function PartConstants.composeRotation(order, rotXdeg, rotYdeg, rotZdeg)
	local rxCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotXdeg), 0, 0)
	local ryCF = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rotYdeg), 0)
	local rzCF = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(rotZdeg))
	if order == "LocalXYZ" then return rxCF * ryCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalXZY" then return rxCF * rzCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalYXZ" then return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalYZX" then return ryCF * rzCF * rxCF end
	if order == "LocalZXY" then return rzCF * rxCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalZYX" then return rzCF * ryCF * rxCF end
	return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF -- Global default
end

PartConstants.DirectionVectors = {
	[Enum.NormalId.Top]    = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Bottom] = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Front]  = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Back]   = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Left]   = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Right]  = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = 1},
}

-- Each shape returns (offset, lookAtRotation, outwardDirection).
-- rotation applied only when LookAtInitially is true; direction sign-modulated by ShapeInOut.
PartConstants.shapeFunctions = {
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box] = function(p, emitter)
		local Px = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.X / 2
		local Py = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Y / 2
		local Pz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Z / 2
		-- Box has no radial; use offset.Unit (origin-aligned falls back to world up).
		local offset = Vector3.new(Px, Py, Pz)
		local dir = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and offset.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
		local sRot = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -dir) or CFrame.new()
		return offset, sRot, dir
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere] = function(p, emitter)
		local outerRadius = p.Size.X / 2
		local innerRadius = outerRadius * emitter.ShapePartial
		local randomRadius = (math.random() * (outerRadius^3 - innerRadius^3) + innerRadius^3)^(1/3)
		local theta = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local phi = math.acos((math.random() * 2) - 1)
		local direction = Vector3.new(
			math.sin(phi) * math.cos(theta),
			math.sin(phi) * math.sin(theta),
			math.cos(phi)
		)
		return direction * randomRadius, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		local height = p.Size.Y
		-- Area-uniform annulus radius: F^-1(u) = sqrt(u*(1-h^2) + h^2).
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadius = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadius * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local y = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (height / 2)
		local z = randomRadius * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
		local direction
		if math.abs(y) > (height / 2) - 0.01 then
			direction = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(y), 0)
		else
			local lateral = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
			if lateral.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
				direction = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			else
				direction = lateral.Unit
			end
		end
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		-- Area-uniform annulus; matches Cylinder.
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadiusRatio = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local z = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
		if localOffset.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return localOffset, CFrame.new(), Vector3.yAxis
		end
		local direction = localOffset.Unit
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
}

-- Apply PosX/Y/Z range offset to simCF.
-- simFrameCF: WORLD CFrame of the frame the caller's simCF is in. nil = world-space
-- sim (Part/Model siblings). For Attachment Emit: walked-up BasePart's CFrame. For
-- Attachment Animate: source attachment's WorldCFrame (composes arbitrary nest depth).
function PartConstants.applyPositionOffset(simCF, data, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, simFrameCF, scaleFactor)
	-- AxisLinks-aware sampling so linked Pos followers stay correlated; emitCtx drives
	-- PosXEven/PosYEven/PosZEven even spread. Independent sampling is the fallback.
	local pxS, pyS, pzS
	if AxisLinksMod and data.AxisLinks then
		local s = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
		pxS, pyS, pzS = s.PosX, s.PosY, s.PosZ
	else
		pxS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosX or NumberRange.new(0))
		pyS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosY or NumberRange.new(0))
		pzS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosZ or NumberRange.new(0))
	end
	local px, py, pz = pxS, pyS, pzS
	-- Nested-Model scale: a 2x model spawns its particles' Pos spread 2x wider.
	if scaleFactor and scaleFactor ~= 1 then
		px, py, pz = px * scaleFactor, py * scaleFactor, pz * scaleFactor
	end
	if px == 0 and py == 0 and pz == 0 then return simCF end
	local posMode = data.PosMode or "Local"

	if posMode == "Local" then
		return simCF * CFrame.new(px, py, pz)
	end

	local offset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
	local worldOffset
	if posMode == "Global" then
		worldOffset = offset
	else -- RigidLocal: rotate by source's WORLD frame; composes through full nest chain.
		local rotCF
		if link then
			rotCF = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
			rotCF = item.WorldCFrame
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then
			rotCF = item:GetPivot()
		else
			rotCF = item.CFrame
		end
		worldOffset = rotCF:VectorToWorldSpace(offset)
	end

	-- Convert world offset → caller's sim frame. nil = sim is world-space.
	local applyOffset = simFrameCF and simFrameCF:VectorToObjectSpace(worldOffset) or worldOffset
	return CFrame.new(simCF.Position + applyOffset) * simCF.Rotation
end

-- Resolve a PosOffset graph sample (rawOff) into world-frame displacement based on
-- DisplacementMode. Shared across all 6 emit paths (Part/Attachment/Model × normal/animate)
-- and Update.luau's per-frame _posOffsetFrameDelta. Three modes:
--   "Global"     → no rotation (world axes)
--   "RigidLocal" → rotated by emitterRot (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ)
--   "Local" (or unknown) → rotated by spawnRot (post-RotXYZ particle frame)
--
-- Optional mirrorX/Y/Z axes apply a post-rotation orthogonal transform  -  used by
-- OnHit Bounce to reflect the PosOffset trajectory about hit normals. Each bounce
-- reflects all three axes about hit.Normal, accumulating as a single 3-vector basis
-- (det may flip to -1 after an odd number of bounces  -  valid for displacement).
-- nil mirror axes (default at spawn) skip the matrix application.
function PartConstants.resolveDisplacement(rawOff, mode, spawnRot, emitterRot, mirrorX, mirrorY, mirrorZ)
	local frameOff
	if mode == "Global" then
		frameOff = rawOff
	elseif mode == "RigidLocal" then
		frameOff = emitterRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	else
		frameOff = spawnRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	end
	if mirrorX then
		return mirrorX * frameOff.X + mirrorY * frameOff.Y + mirrorZ * frameOff.Z
	end
	return frameOff
end

-- Skip Coulomb cancellation when |a · n| below this  -  body parallel to surface
-- (vertical-wall-grazing case) shouldn't have its full gravity stripped.
local FREEFALL_THRESHOLD = 10

-- Coulomb contact-constraint shaping for gravity during settle. Strips normal
-- component (surface reaction force) + applies friction force on tangent vel
-- bounded by μ·|aN|. Yields standard inclined-plane dynamics: g·sinθ − μ·g·cosθ.
function PartConstants.applyContactAccel(accel, pData, dt)
	if not (pData._settleEngaged and pData._lastHitNormal) then return accel end
	local n = pData._lastHitNormal
	if n.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return accel end
	local aN_dot = accel:Dot(n)
	-- Surface only pushes (Newton's 3rd is one-directional). Gravity pointing
	-- AWAY from surface means no contact, no constraint.
	if aN_dot >= 0 then return accel end
	-- Vertical-wall escape: body parallel to surface normal has near-zero
	-- normal component. Skip constraint so gravity drags it along the wall.
	if math.abs(aN_dot) < FREEFALL_THRESHOLD then return accel end
	local aN = aN_dot * n
	local aT = accel - aN
	local mu = (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit and pData.Events.OnHit.Friction) or 0.2
	local vT = Vector3.zero
	if pData._accelVel then
		local av = pData._accelVel
		vT = av - av:Dot(n) * n
	end
	local vT_mag = vT.Magnitude
	local maxFrictionAccel = mu * math.abs(aN_dot)
	if vT_mag > 1e-4 then
		-- Kinetic regime: friction opposes tangent velocity, capped at Coulomb cone.
		-- Static-lock clamp prevents friction from reversing tangent vel in one step.
		local frictionAccel = (-vT.Unit) * maxFrictionAccel
		if maxFrictionAccel * (dt or 1/60) > vT_mag then
			frictionAccel = -vT / (dt or 1/60)
		end
		return aT + frictionAccel
	end
	-- Static regime: |aT| ≤ μ·|aN| means friction holds the body still
	-- (tan(θ) ≤ μ on a slope). |aT| > μ·|aN| means slope exceeds friction cone;
	-- body starts sliding at the residual tangent accel.
	local aT_mag = aT.Magnitude
	if aT_mag <= maxFrictionAccel then return Vector3.zero end
	return aT - aT.Unit * maxFrictionAccel
end

return PartConstants

-- Particles  -  fires native ParticleEmitters/Trails inside a transformed item using the
-- EmitCount / EmitDelay / EmitDuration attributes. Per-instance gen tokens prevent stale
-- delayed-off closures from clobbering newer emit sessions.
-- Particle.fireEmitter is the ONE place a native ParticleEmitter is fired from: EnableEmit and
-- EnableEmitSingle here, the raw-emitter branch of Part/init.luau and the plugin's Emit button
-- (EmitDispatch) all call it, so its EmitMode attribute means the same everywhere.
local Range = require(script.Parent.Range)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
local EmitterBursts = require(script.Parent.EmitterBursts)

local Particle = {}

-- EmitDuration is a number or a "min,max" range string; parse to scalar.
local function parseDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return nil end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local text = tostring(raw)
	local vals = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if n then table.insert(vals, n) end end
	if #vals == 0 then return nil end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	local mn, mx = math.min(vals[1], vals[2]), math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
	return Range.RandomValueFromRange(NumberRange.new(mn, mx))
end
Particle.parseDuration = parseDuration

-- Skip descendants under a nested Transformed item (sub-emitter handles those itself).
local function _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, root)
	local p = desc.Parent
	while p and p ~= root do
		if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- alive: false when engine session ended; cancels delayed STARTS only.
local function _alive(alive)
	return (not alive) or alive()
end

-- Two gens, split responsibilities. CANCEL_GEN gates delayed starts (bumped by
-- CancelNative / Pool release / Disable). DURATION_GEN gates delayed-off closures
-- (bumped on each duration-window start) so a newer window can't be turned off
-- by an older one.
local CANCEL_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeEmitGen"
local DURATION_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeDurationGen"

local function _readCancelGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpCancelGen(v)
	local gen = _readCancelGen(v) + 1
	EngineAttr.write(v, CANCEL_GEN_ATTR, gen)
	return gen
end
local function _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readCancelGen(v) == gen
end

local function _readDurationGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpDurationGen(v)
	local gen = _readDurationGen(v) + 1
	EngineAttr.write(v, DURATION_GEN_ATTR, gen)
	return gen
end
local function _durationGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readDurationGen(v) == gen
end

-- Enabled=true now, schedule Enabled=false in `duration`. Delayed-off owned by
-- duration gen so a later SetEnabledForDuration does not get clobbered.
Particle.SetEnabledForDuration = function(v, duration)
	local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
	EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
	end)
end

-- External API kept stable: ReadNativeGen / IsNativeGenCurrent address the
-- cancel token (delayed-start gating). Callers that want delayed-off ownership
-- use SetEnabledForDuration which handles its own duration token internally.
Particle.ReadNativeGen = _readCancelGen
Particle.IsNativeGenCurrent = _cancelGenStillCurrent

-- Bump cancel + duration gens + Enabled=false. Invalidates pending delayed
-- starts AND any pending delayed-off (which would otherwise re-toggle).
Particle.CancelNative = function(v)
	_bumpCancelGen(v)
	_bumpDurationGen(v)
	pcall(function() EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end)
end

-- Fires one native ParticleEmitter as its attributes say, after its EmitDelay.
--   EmitMode "Burst": EmitCount particles every 1 / Rate seconds for EmitDuration (EmitterBursts).
--   anything else (Auto): EmitCount particles once, then enabled for EmitDuration when that is set.
-- EmitCount defaults to 1. Zero-as-zero: nothing to emit and no duration fires nothing.
-- cancelGen is read here, before any delay, so a Disable during EmitDelay stops the start.
Particle.fireEmitter = function(emitter, alive)
	local count = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1
	local emitDelay = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
	local emitDuration = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
	local bursts = emitter:GetAttribute("EmitMode") == "Burst"
	if count <= 0 and (bursts or emitDuration <= 0) then return end
	local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(emitter)
	local function start()
		if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(emitter, cancelGen) then return end
		if bursts then
			-- A train owns the duration gen as an enabled window does: a newer emit of this
			-- emitter, or CancelNative, ends it.
			local durationGen = _bumpDurationGen(emitter)
			if emitter.Enabled then EngineAttr.writeProp(emitter, "Enabled", false) end
			EmitterBursts.start(emitter, count, emitDuration, function()
				return _alive(alive) and _durationGenStillCurrent(emitter, durationGen)
			end)
			return
		end
		-- Roblox :Emit(0) falls back to 1; gate on count>0.
		if count > 0 then emitter:Emit(count) end
		if emitDuration > 0 then Particle.SetEnabledForDuration(emitter, emitDuration) end
	end
	if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, start) else start() end
end

-- Synchronous dispatch over everything a holder carries.
Particle.EnableEmit = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetDescendants() do
		if _hasTransformedAncestor(v, part) then continue end
		if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
			Particle.fireEmitter(v, alive)
		end
		-- Skip TrailEmitter (Transformed)  -  the engine pipeline emits cloned visuals
		-- via TrailEmitter.EmitTrail; toggling the SOURCE Trail's Enabled here would
		-- render the unwanted source Trail at default Roblox properties (white) on
		-- top of the authored emit clones.
		if v:IsA('Trail') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
			if dur and dur > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				task.delay(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0.001, function()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(dur, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		-- Raw Beam: native streak between authored attachments. Skip BeamNative
		-- (Transformed)  -  directAccess type handled by Particle:EnableEmit mixin.
		-- Same gen-token pattern as Trail: cancelGen gates delayed-on, durGen owns delayed-off.
		if v:IsA('Beam') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local emitDuration = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
			local emitDelay = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay')) or 0
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				local function doEmit()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end
				if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
			end
		end
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitSingle = function(v: Instance, alive)
	-- A Transformed source has its own emit pipeline; enabling it here would render the
	-- source Trail in place / double-fire a nested PE.
	if v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then return end
	if v:IsA('Trail') then
		local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
		if dur and dur > 0 then
			local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
			local emitDelay = v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
			local function doEnable()
				if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
				local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
				EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
				task.delay(dur, function()
					if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
				end)
			end
			-- Synchronous enable when EmitDelay=0 so trail renders on the SAME
			-- frame as particle spawn. Prior `task.delay(EmitDelay or 0.001, ...)`
			-- forced a 1ms tick gap even with zero delay → trail invisible on
			-- frame 0, visible from frame 1+. For short-lived particles this is
			-- a noticeable gap in the trail head.
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEnable) else doEnable() end
		end
	end
	if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
		Particle.fireEmitter(v, alive)
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetChildren() do
		Particle.EnableEmitSingle(v, alive)
		if v:IsA('Attachment') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(v, alive)
		end
	end
end

return Particle

--[[
	PlayHandle  -  the per-play "ghost" returned by Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt.

	One AbsoluteEmitAt call spawns particles from a SHARED source without cloning it. The
	handle wraps a play token so a caller controls only THAT play, never the shared source:
	many callers can drive one emitter and stop / timescale / script their own play in
	isolation. No Instance is created (honors the no-duplication optimization) — the handle
	is a plain Lua object over { engine, token }.

	token = { Alive, Loops = {task,..}, Clones = {Instance,..}, TsOverride, TsUntil, Duration }.
	Particles of this play carry pData._playToken == token (stamped in RegisterEmit). The
	continuous loop (Lifecycle.Enable) breaks when token.Alive flips false and registers its
	task in token.Loops. Branch-B raw clones land in token.Clones for early teardown.

	API:
	  :Disable()      hard  -  stop new emission, reclaim live particles now, destroy clones.
	  :SoftDisable()  soft  -  stop new emission, live particles finish their Lifetime.
	  :SetTimescale(scale, duration, permanent)  -  per-play time warp; no source attr write.
	  :GetParticles() -> {VisualPart,..} live visuals of this play (script them directly).
	  :GetPDatas()    -> {pData,..} raw pData refs of live particles. ENGINE-INTERNAL
	                    layout: read LifeTime / StartTime / LocalCF / Graphs / Seeds /
	                    SkipSize / BaseDirection / etc. Mutations stick until the next
	                    Heartbeat reads them. NO STABILITY GUARANTEE between plugin
	                    versions  -  field renames will break callers.
	  :IsAlive()  /  .Active  -  any live particle or non-dead loop remains.
	  :Wait()         yield until the play ends: Duration elapsed, or disabled with nothing
	                  left alive. Returns the seconds waited. An infinite play waits for Disable.
	  .Duration   -  total real-time duration of the play (nil = infinite).
	  PlayHandle.inert(engine)  -  handle of a rejected call: never alive, controls nothing.
]]

local PlayHandle = {}

local Methods = {}

-- Hard stop: halt new emission, reclaim every live particle of this play now, destroy
-- branch-B clones. Mirrors Particle:Disable's swap-and-pop sweep, filtered by play token.
function Methods:Disable()
	local engine = self.engine
	-- Queue during the Heartbeat loop; Engine drains after the sweep (see Particle:Disable).
	if engine._inStep then
		engine._afterStep = engine._afterStep or {}
		table.insert(engine._afterStep, function() self:Disable() end)
		return
	end
	local token = self.token
	token.Alive = false
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(token.Loops) do pcall(task.cancel, loopTask) end
	token.Loops = {}

	local active = engine.ActiveEmits
	for idx = #active, 1, -1 do
		local pData = active[idx]
		if pData and pData._playToken == token then
			if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
				engine:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
			end
			engine:_reclaimPData(pData)
			if active[idx] == pData then
				local n = #active
				if idx < n then active[idx] = active[n] end
				active[n] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	for _, clone in ipairs(token.Clones) do
		if clone and clone.Parent then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end) end
	end
	token.Clones = {}
end

-- Soft stop: halt new emission; live particles finish their Lifetime and branch-B clones
-- expire on their own destroy delay. Cancels only the emission loop.
-- Engine's Animate replay reads token.Alive, so a looping Animate play ends after its current cycle.
function Methods:SoftDisable()
	local token = self.token
	token.Alive = false
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(token.Loops) do pcall(task.cancel, loopTask) end
	token.Loops = {}
end

-- Per-play timescale window. Patches this play's live particles and stores the window on the
-- token so the play's future emits inherit it (RegisterEmit). Never writes to the source item,
-- so other plays + the source stay at their own speed. permanent=true ignores duration;
-- duration<=0 (non-permanent) clears the override.
function Methods:SetTimescale(scale, duration, permanent)
	if typeof(scale) ~= "number" then return end
	local engine = self.engine
	local token = self.token
	local until_
	if permanent == true then
		until_ = math.huge
	elseif typeof(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then
		until_ = os.clock() + duration
	else
		token.TsOverride = nil
		token.TsUntil = nil
		until_ = nil
	end
	token.TsOverride = until_ ~= nil and scale or nil
	token.TsUntil = until_
	local active = engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == token then
			pData._tsOverride = token.TsOverride
			pData._tsOverrideUntil = until_
		end
	end
end

-- Live visuals of this play, for direct scripting of the emitted items.
function Methods:GetParticles()
	local out = {}
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == self.token and pData.VisualPart then
			out[#out + 1] = pData.VisualPart
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Raw pData refs for live particles of this play. pData layout is engine-internal;
-- scripters use this to override anything (Graphs / Seeds / LocalCF / SkipSize /
-- LifeTime / etc) per-frame. Mutations land on the next Heartbeat read. No
-- stability guarantee between plugin versions.
function Methods:GetPDatas()
	local out = {}
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == self.token then
			out[#out + 1] = pData
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- True while any live particle carries the token or any emission loop is still running.
function Methods:IsAlive()
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		if active[i] and active[i]._playToken == self.token then return true end
	end
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(self.token.Loops) do
		if coroutine.status(loopTask) ~= "dead" then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- Yield until the play ends. Duration is the upper bound (spawns wait on EmitDelay, so liveness
-- alone cannot detect the end); an early Disable returns as soon as nothing is left alive.
function Methods:Wait()
	local start = os.clock()
	local duration = self.Duration
	while true do
		if duration ~= nil and os.clock() - start >= duration then break end
		if self.token.Alive == false and not Methods.IsAlive(self) then break end
		task.wait()
	end
	return os.clock() - start
end

local HandleMeta = {}
-- .Active resolves live; .Duration + methods are real fields / the Methods table.
HandleMeta.__index = function(handle, key)
	if key == "Active" then return Methods.IsAlive(handle) end
	return Methods[key]
end

function PlayHandle.new(engine, token)
	return setmetatable({ engine = engine, token = token, Duration = token.Duration }, HandleMeta)
end

-- Handle for a rejected call so callers can chain methods without nil checks.
function PlayHandle.inert(engine)
	return PlayHandle.new(engine, { Alive = false, Loops = {}, Clones = {}, Duration = 0 })
end

return PlayHandle

--[[
	Light mixin  -  Emit + Update for PointLight / SpotLight / SurfaceLight particles.
	Property-only animation (Range / Brightness / Color / Angle over life), no spatial motion.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)

return function(Particle)

function Particle:UpdatePointLight(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Timescale v2 (signed reverse): see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	-- Riding a parent visual: die when the parent pData reclaims (see EmitPointLight).
	if pData._parentAlive and not pData._parentAlive[1] then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		local range, brightness, color, angle
		if pData.Graphs.PLRange then
			range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLRange, pData.Seeds.PLRange)
			pData.VisualPart.Range = range
		end
		if pData.Graphs.PLBrightness and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLBrightness, pData.Seeds.PLBrightness)
			pData.VisualPart.Brightness = brightness
		end
		if pData.Graphs.PLColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLColor)
			pData.VisualPart.Color = color
		end
		if pData._hasCone and pData.Graphs.PLAngle then
			angle = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLAngle, pData.Seeds.PLAngle)
			pData.VisualPart.Angle = angle
		end
		local extras = pData._extraLights
		if extras then
			for j = 1, #extras do
				local extraLight = extras[j]
				if range then extraLight.Range = range end
				if brightness then extraLight.Brightness = brightness end
				if color then extraLight.Color = color end
				if angle then extraLight.Angle = angle end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

function Particle:EmitPointLight(light, link, emitCtx)
	if not light or not light.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(light, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visualLight = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight", data.Pool)
	visualLight.Archivable = false
	visualLight.Enabled = true
	if data.Shadows ~= nil then visualLight.Shadows = data.Shadows end
	-- EmitParent (user intent) > link (a local clone) > a carrier mirroring the source's parent so
	-- the light never parents into the user's own part (Team Create replication).
	local parentPart = data.EmitParent or link
	local carrier = nil
	if not parentPart then
		local anchor = light.Parent
		if anchor and (anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor:IsA("Attachment")) then
			carrier = VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
			parentPart = carrier
		else
			parentPart = anchor
		end
	end
	-- Lights only render under a BasePart/Attachment. A Model link resolves to a
	-- BasePart child: middle part for Model emitters; ALL segments for Lightning
	-- bolts (per-segment clone fan-out below so the whole bolt glows).
	local boltParts = nil
	if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("Model") then
		local parts = nil
		for _, child in ipairs(parentPart:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts = parts or {}
				parts[#parts + 1] = child
			end
		end
		if parts then
			if parentPart:GetAttribute("_lightningBolt") then
				boltParts = parts
				parentPart = parts[1]
			else
				parentPart = parts[math.ceil(#parts / 2)]
			end
		end
	end

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedRange = data.PLRange and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLRange) or {}
	local seedBright = data.PLBrightness and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLBrightness) or {}
	local seedAngle = data.PLAngle and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLAngle) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLTimescale)

	-- Apply initial values before parenting (1-frame pop prevention).
	if data.PLRange then
		visualLight.Range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLRange, seedRange)
	end
	if data.PLBrightness then
		visualLight.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLBrightness, seedBright)
	end
	if data.PLColor then
		visualLight.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.PLColor)
	end
	-- Spot / Surface lights carry a cone; PointLight has neither Angle nor Face.
	local hasCone = visualLight:IsA("SpotLight") or visualLight:IsA("SurfaceLight")
	if hasCone then
		if data.PLFace then visualLight.Face = data.PLFace end
		if data.PLAngle then visualLight.Angle = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLAngle, seedAngle) end
	end

	visualLight.Parent = parentPart

	-- Lightning per-segment fan-out: clone the initialized light onto every other
	-- segment; UpdatePointLight drives clones with the same stepped values and
	-- _releaseOrDestroy destroys them (pooled bolts must not retain foreign lights).
	-- Archivable flips because Clone() returns nil on Archivable=false instances.
	local extraLights = nil
	if boltParts and #boltParts > 1 then
		visualLight.Archivable = true
		extraLights = table.create(#boltParts - 1)
		for j = 2, #boltParts do
			local extra = visualLight:Clone()
			extra.Archivable = false
			extra.Parent = boltParts[j]
			extraLights[j - 1] = extra
		end
		visualLight.Archivable = false
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "PointLight",
		_carrier = carrier,
		_hasCone = hasCone,
		VisualPart = visualLight,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		Graphs = {
			PLRange = data.PLRange,
			PLBrightness = data.PLBrightness,
			PLColor = data.PLColor,
			PLAngle = data.PLAngle,
			Timescale = data.PLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			PLRange = seedRange,
			PLBrightness = seedBright,
			PLAngle = seedAngle,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.PLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = light
	pData._extraLights = extraLights
	-- Parented INSIDE the emitted visual, the light must die with it, or a pooled
	-- parent carries live foreign lights back into the pool (ghost lights on
	-- reuse). EmitParent'd lights live elsewhere and keep their own lifetime.
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and not data.EmitParent then
		pData._parentAlive = emitCtx._parentAlive
	end
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, light)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

--[[
	Pool  -  emission-driven object pool for emitted particle visuals.
	Per-source LIFO with hard cap + ring-buffer overflow + TTL eviction. Cap = rate*TTL*1.25 + 8.
	Generational invalidation via `_PoolGen` attribute (TypeRegistry.write bumps on edit).
	Animate mode skips pooling (visual IS the live source).
]]

local PoolHide = require(script.Parent.PoolHide)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local Pool = {}

-- Idle-pool destination folder (VisualHost owns it). Live emit clones stay in `EmittedPartsUsingPart_icle`
-- (Particle:GetFolder); only entries that finished an emit cycle land here.
local function _getPoolFolder()
	return VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
end

-- Weak-key so a destroyed RenderTemplate's pool entry can gc instead of leaking
-- the source instance + cached visuals across un-transform / re-transform cycles.
Pool._pools = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})  -- [sourceRT] = {entries, gen, cap, peakSize, hits, misses, evictions}
Pool._totalSize = 0
Pool._lastSweepAt = 0
Pool._lastReportAt = 0
-- Bumped per release; particles capture it at emit so a recycled clone is no longer their link.
Pool._releaseGen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL = 2048
Pool.TTL = 5
Pool.SWEEP_INTERVAL = 2
Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL = 0        -- 0 disables the periodic Output print
Pool.MIN_CAP = 8
Pool.CAP_SAFETY = 1.25

local function estimateCap(rate)
	local r = math.max(rate or 0, 0)
	return math.ceil(r * Pool.TTL * Pool.CAP_SAFETY) + Pool.MIN_CAP
end

local function getOrInitPool(source)
	local p = Pool._pools[source]
	if p then return p end
	p = {
		entries = {},                              -- LIFO of {instance, pooledAt}
		gen = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0,
		cap = Pool.MIN_CAP,
		peakSize = 0,
		hits = 0, misses = 0, evictions = 0,
	}
	Pool._pools[source] = p
	return p
end

-- Luau weak keys are not ephemerons: a map whose value references its own key (map[rt] = clone)
-- never collects, so every Destroy path drops the clone's map explicitly.
function Pool.dropCloneMap(instance)
	if instance and Pool._cloneMaps then Pool._cloneMaps[instance] = nil end
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	if entry and entry.instance then
		Pool.dropCloneMap(entry.instance)
		pcall(function() entry.instance:Destroy() end)
	end
end

local function discardAllEntries(pool)
	for i = 1, #pool.entries do destroyEntry(pool.entries[i]) end
	Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - #pool.entries)
	pool.entries = {}
end

-- Pop a live entry or nil. Caller restores all visual properties (same as fresh Clone).
function Pool.acquire(source, kind)
	if not source then return nil end
	local pool = getOrInitPool(source)
	local sourceGen = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	if sourceGen ~= pool.gen then
		-- Generation drifted; flush all entries.
		discardAllEntries(pool)
		pool.gen = sourceGen
	end
	while #pool.entries > 0 do
		local entry = table.remove(pool.entries)
		Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
		local inst = entry.instance
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			PoolHide.show(inst, kind)
			pool.hits += 1
			return inst
		end
	end
	pool.misses += 1
	return nil
end

-- Push an instance back. Global cap → Destroy instead. Per-source full → ring-evict oldest.
function Pool.release(instance, source, kind, rate)
	if not instance or not source then return end
	if not instance.Parent then return end
	local pool = getOrInitPool(source)
	if rate then pool.cap = estimateCap(rate) end
	if Pool._totalSize >= Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL then
		Pool.dropCloneMap(instance)
		pcall(function() instance:Destroy() end)
		return
	end
	while #pool.entries >= pool.cap do
		local oldest = table.remove(pool.entries, 1)  -- O(n) shift, n <= cap
		Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
		destroyEntry(oldest)
		pool.evictions += 1
	end
	PoolHide.hide(instance, kind)
	Pool._releaseGen[instance] = (Pool._releaseGen[instance] or 0) + 1
	-- Re-parent idle entry into the visible pool folder so the user can see, at any moment,
	-- which clones are recyclable. PoolHide already teleported / disabled it; reparent now
	-- so the Explorer reflects the idle state.
	pcall(function() instance.Parent = _getPoolFolder() end)
	pool.entries[#pool.entries + 1] = { instance = instance, pooledAt = os.clock() }
	Pool._totalSize += 1
	if #pool.entries > pool.peakSize then pool.peakSize = #pool.entries end
end

function Pool.linkGen(instance)
	return Pool._releaseGen[instance] or 0
end

-- TTL sweep with 64-entry budget. Budget caps frame-time on huge pools.
function Pool.tickSweep(now)
	if (now - Pool._lastSweepAt) < Pool.SWEEP_INTERVAL then return end
	Pool._lastSweepAt = now
	local budget = 64
	-- Collect drained sources to drop after iteration; mutating Pool._pools while
	-- iterating it would skip / double-visit entries. A pool is droppable when its
	-- entries list is empty AND its source RT has been destroyed (no Parent), so
	-- live RTs that just hit a quiet stretch keep their stats.
	local toDrop = nil
	for source, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		local i = 1
		while i <= #pool.entries and budget > 0 do
			local entry = pool.entries[i]
			local inst = entry.instance
			local stale = (now - entry.pooledAt) > Pool.TTL or not inst or not inst.Parent
			if stale then
				destroyEntry(entry)
				local n = #pool.entries
				if i < n then pool.entries[i] = pool.entries[n] end
				pool.entries[n] = nil
				Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
				pool.evictions += 1
				budget -= 1
				-- Don't advance i; current slot now holds what was at the end.
			else
				i += 1
			end
		end
		if #pool.entries == 0 and (not source or not source.Parent) then
			toDrop = toDrop or {}
			toDrop[#toDrop + 1] = source
		end
	end
	if toDrop then
		for _, source in ipairs(toDrop) do
			Pool._pools[source] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Called from TypeRegistry.write to invalidate stale-look pool entries.
function Pool.bumpGen(source)
	if not source then return end
	local cur = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() source:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

-- Drop one source's pool when its RT is destroyed.
function Pool.flushSource(source)
	local pool = Pool._pools[source]
	if not pool then return end
	discardAllEntries(pool)
	Pool._pools[source] = nil
end

-- Drop every pool; called from Particle:Deactivate.
function Pool.flushAll()
	for _, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		discardAllEntries(pool)
	end
	Pool._pools = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
	Pool._totalSize = 0
	Pool._cloneMaps = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
end

-- Aggregate diagnostics print, gated by REPORT_INTERVAL.
function Pool.tickReport(now)
	if Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL <= 0 then return end
	if (now - Pool._lastReportAt) < Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL then return end
	Pool._lastReportAt = now
	local poolCount, totalEntries, totalHits, totalMisses, totalEvictions, peakAcross = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	for _ in pairs(Pool._pools) do poolCount += 1 end
	for _, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		totalEntries += #pool.entries
		totalHits += pool.hits
		totalMisses += pool.misses
		totalEvictions += pool.evictions
		if pool.peakSize > peakAcross then peakAcross = pool.peakSize end
	end
	local hitRate = (totalHits + totalMisses) > 0 and (totalHits / (totalHits + totalMisses) * 100) or 0
	Log.print(string.format(
		"[Part-Icles Pool] sources=%d entries=%d/%d peak=%d hits=%d misses=%d (%.1f%% hit) evictions=%d",
		poolCount, totalEntries, Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL, peakAcross, totalHits, totalMisses, hitRate, totalEvictions
	))
end

-- Acquire or Clone. Stamps _PartIcleEmit so downstream readers recognize the instance.
-- `pooled=false` forces a fresh clone every time and skips the release path; nested
-- Trails/PEs inside the visual then always reflect their authored RT properties.
function Pool.acquireOrClone(rt, kind, pooled)
	local inst
	if pooled == false then
		inst = rt:Clone()
	else
		inst = Pool.acquire(rt, kind) or rt:Clone()
	end
	inst:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return inst
end

local END_PROPERTIES = { "Attachment0", "Attachment1" }

-- Clone map -> { { clone, property, source }, ... }: stock Beam / Trail ends authored against
-- a transformed Attachment. The copy skips that attachment (it is emitted later), so the end
-- waits here until Pool.registerEmitted binds it.
local lateEnds = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- Rebuild RT subtree via Instance.fromExisting, skipping Transformed branches
-- (nested SOURCE Part-Icles - fired separately by NestedEmit). Builds a source-to
-- -clone map for the rebuilt subtree.
local function copyBare(source, map, isRoot)
	map = map or {}
	local bare = Instance.fromExisting(source)
	map[source] = bare
	for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
		-- Skip nested sources (fired separately) and any live emitted visual that landed here.
		if not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not child:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then
			copyBare(child, map, false).Parent = bare
		end
	end
	-- Rebind intra-subtree Trail/Beam Attachment0/1. fromExisting copies refs
	-- verbatim; only Instance:Clone auto-rebinds. An end on a transformed Attachment is
	-- queued in lateEnds; any other map miss (an attachment outside the subtree) keeps
	-- its authored reference.
	if isRoot == nil or isRoot then
		local late = nil
		for src, clone in pairs(map) do
			if src:IsA("Trail") or src:IsA("Beam") then
				for _, property in ipairs(END_PROPERTIES) do
					local authored = src[property]
					if authored and map[authored] then
						clone[property] = map[authored]
					elseif authored and authored:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						late = late or {}
						table.insert(late, { clone = clone, property = property, source = authored })
					end
				end
			end
		end
		lateEnds[map] = late
	end
	return bare, map
end
Pool.copyBare = copyBare

-- Records `visual` as the emitted copy of the transformed `source` in a parent's clone map
-- and binds the stock Beam / Trail ends that were waiting for it. Writes own entries only:
-- the map may chain to a grandparent's. Consumer: EmitAttachment.
function Pool.registerEmitted(map, source, visual)
	rawset(map, source, visual)
	local late = lateEnds[map]
	if not late then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(late) do
		if entry.source == source then entry.clone[entry.property] = visual end
	end
end

-- A reused clone starts like a fresh copy: late ends back on their authored attachment and
-- the previous cycle's emitted attachments forgotten.
local function resetLateEnds(map)
	local late = lateEnds[map]
	if not late then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(late) do
		entry.clone[entry.property] = entry.source
		rawset(map, entry.source, nil)
	end
end

-- Weak-keyed by clone root. Map auto-GC's with the clone; pool-hits reuse it
-- until _PoolGen drifts (mutation evicts pool entry, next acquire rebuilds).
Pool._cloneMaps = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

function Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(rt, kind, pooled)
	local inst, map
	if pooled == false then
		inst, map = copyBare(rt)
	else
		inst = Pool.acquire(rt, kind)
		if inst then
			map = Pool._cloneMaps[inst]
			if map then resetLateEnds(map) end
		else
			inst, map = copyBare(rt)
		end
	end
	if map then Pool._cloneMaps[inst] = map end
	inst:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return inst
end

-- Call AFTER writing new spawn CFrame + parent. Defers Trail.Enabled flip by one
-- Heartbeat so Roblox's renderer has applied the new attachment positions before the
-- Trail starts emitting; otherwise the first segment can be drawn from a stale cached
-- position (the prior emit's death pose) to the new spawn pose, leaving a visible
-- streak. No-op on fresh clones (no `_pooledTrailEnabled` snapshot to restore).
function Pool.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	task.delay(0, function()
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
		PoolHide.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	end)
end

-- Heartbeat hook; both subsystems gate on their own intervals.
function Pool.tick(now)
	Pool.tickSweep(now)
	Pool.tickReport(now)
end

function Pool.stats()
	local out = { totalSize = Pool._totalSize, sources = {} }
	for source, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		out.sources[source] = {
			size = #pool.entries, peakSize = pool.peakSize, cap = pool.cap, gen = pool.gen,
			hits = pool.hits, misses = pool.misses, evictions = pool.evictions,
		}
	end
	return out
end

return Pool

--[[
	PoolHide  -  type-dispatched hide/show for pooled visuals.

	hide:  Part/Model  → CFrame teleport to far-away (Trails disabled first to avoid streak)
	       Beam/PointLight → Enabled=false
	       Attachment → no-op
	show:  no-op (Trails restored separately via PoolHide.restoreTrails after the
	       caller writes the new spawn CFrame).

	Caller's emit-setup re-writes Size / CFrame / Color / Transparency on acquire;
	PoolHide does not restore any rendering properties.
]]

local FAR_AWAY = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(FAR_AWAY)

local PoolHide = {}

-- Snapshot + disable every Trail descendant; runs BEFORE teleport to avoid a streak.
-- Also snapshot + zero Lifetime so existing segments expire instantly instead of persisting
-- across the teleport (Enabled=false only stops NEW segments; old ones live for Lifetime
-- seconds and render between the pre/post-teleport attachment positions = visible streak).
-- Skip snapshot when one already pending so a same-frame acquire→release race
-- can't overwrite the authored value with a transient false.
local function disableTrails(root)
	if root:IsA("Trail") then
		pcall(function()
			if root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") == nil then
				root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", root.Enabled)
			end
			if root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime") == nil then
				root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", root.Lifetime)
			end
			root.Lifetime = 0
			root.Enabled = false
		end)
		return
	end
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") == nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", desc.Enabled)
				end
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime") == nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", desc.Lifetime)
				end
				desc.Lifetime = 0
				desc.Enabled = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Restore each Trail's Lifetime + Enabled from snapshot, clear the attributes for next cycle.
local function restoreTrails(root)
	if root:IsA("Trail") then
		pcall(function()
			local priorLife = root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime")
			if priorLife ~= nil then root.Lifetime = priorLife end
			root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", nil)
			local prior = root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled")
			if prior ~= nil then root.Enabled = prior == true end
			root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", nil)
		end)
		return
	end
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				local priorLife = desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime")
				if priorLife ~= nil then desc.Lifetime = priorLife end
				desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", nil)
				local prior = desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled")
				if prior ~= nil then desc.Enabled = prior == true end
				desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", nil)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Bump cancel + duration gens + disable nested ParticleEmitter / Trail descendants.
-- Invalidates pending delayed starts + delayed-off closures from Particles.EnableEmit
-- so stale fires can't land on a reused pooled visual.
local CANCEL_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeEmitGen"
local DURATION_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeDurationGen"
local function cancelNativeDescendants(root)
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				local cancelCur = desc:GetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR) or 0
				desc:SetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR, cancelCur + 1)
				local durCur = desc:GetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR) or 0
				desc:SetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR, durCur + 1)
				desc.Enabled = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

function PoolHide.hide(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end

	if kind == "Part" then
		-- disableTrails must run BEFORE cancelNativeDescendants so the snapshot reads
		-- the authored Trail.Enabled instead of the about-to-be-disabled value.
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			pcall(function() instance.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME end)
		end

	-- Model keeps PivotTo: EmitModel moves clones through the pivot every frame,
	-- so the stored pivot tracks the parts. Lightning maintains WorldPivot per
	-- roll (applyRoll), so PivotTo stays correct there too.
	elseif kind == "Model" or kind == "Lightning" then
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		pcall(function() instance:PivotTo(FAR_CFRAME) end)

	elseif kind == "Rocks" or kind == "Rope" then
		-- Rig kinds move parts with BulkMoveTo, which never updates a
		-- PrimaryPart-less Model's STORED pivot. The first PivotTo(FAR) froze the
		-- pivot at FAR, so later releases computed a zero delta and left chunks
		-- visible on the ground inside the pool folder until the next acquire
		-- snapped them away. Park every part directly; never trust the pivot.
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		for _, chunk in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if chunk:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					chunk.Anchored = true
					chunk.CanCollide = false
					chunk.CanTouch = false
					chunk.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
				end)
			end
		end

	elseif kind == "Beam" then
		-- Snapshot Color + Transparency before disable so reacquire with an empty colorStates
		-- graph restores authored values instead of inheriting the prior cycle's last frame.
		pcall(function()
			if instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor") == nil then
				instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor", instance.Color)
			end
			if instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency") == nil then
				instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency", instance.Transparency)
			end
			instance.Enabled = false
		end)

	elseif kind == "PointLight" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "Highlight" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "TrailEmitter" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "ImageLabel" then
		-- ImageLabel has no .Enabled; .Visible=false is the equivalent hide. Pool.release
		-- re-parents to the pool folder  -  Roblox tolerates GUI under
		-- non-ScreenGui ancestors (just doesn't render until reparented back).
		pcall(function() instance.Visible = false end)

	elseif kind == "Attachment" then
		-- Attachment stays at its real-world pose; cancel native PE/Trail
		-- descendants so stale delayed starts can't re-emit on the pooled
		-- attachment after the custom visual died. disableTrails runs first
		-- so its snapshot reads the authored Trail.Enabled instead of the
		-- about-to-be-disabled value (mirrors Part / Model branches).
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
	-- Visible is intentionally untouched: toggling diverges pooled vs fresh
	-- (Visible defaults false on authored Attachments, exposing a 3D cross gizmo).
	end
end

function PoolHide.show(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
	-- Symmetric with hide: Beam/PointLight/Highlight/TrailEmitter Enabled flip kept self-contained in the pool contract.
	if kind == "Beam" then
		-- Restore authored Color + Transparency from snapshot before re-enable. Emit setup only
		-- writes Color/Transparency when a graph is non-empty (Emit.luau:582-583); without this
		-- restore, pooled Beams reused with no graph keep prior-cycle final-frame values.
		pcall(function()
			local priorColor = instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor")
			if priorColor ~= nil then instance.Color = priorColor end
			instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor", nil)
			local priorTrans = instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency")
			if priorTrans ~= nil then instance.Transparency = priorTrans end
			instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency", nil)
			instance.Enabled = true
		end)
	elseif kind == "PointLight" or kind == "Highlight" or kind == "TrailEmitter" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = true end)
	elseif kind == "ImageLabel" then
		pcall(function() instance.Visible = true end)
	end
	-- Trail restore deferred to PoolHide.restoreTrails (caller sets new CFrame first).
end

-- Call AFTER setting the new spawn CFrame. Restores Trail.Enabled from snapshot. Safe on
-- fresh clones (no `_pooledTrailEnabled` attribute means no-op).
function PoolHide.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
	if kind == "Part" or kind == "Model" or kind == "Attachment" or kind == "Lightning" or kind == "Rocks" or kind == "Rope" then
		restoreTrails(instance)
	end
end

return PoolHide

--[[
	PreSimulate Mixin  -  step-by-step forward motion pre-simulation, split from
	Transform.luau (500-line cap).
	  :PreSimulateForward / :PreSimulateAttachmentForward  -  return local CFrames per
	    step without emitting. Used by Motion Preview, by Emit for InvertMotion's
	    SimLocalCFrames cache, and by EngineReplay's per-cycle cache rebuild.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

return function(Particle)

-- Walk a Part/Beam/Model emit's motion forward step-by-step and return the per-step local CFrames.
-- Called by Motion Preview to draw trajectory lines in the viewport; also reused inside Emit so
-- the live simulation matches the preview without re-deriving the math. The CFrames are local to
-- `parentCF` (Link target or world origin) so a moving Link naturally carries the path with it.
function Particle:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, lifetime, previewMaxSteps, spawnEmitterRotation, linkLocal, maskRefCF)
	local linkMode = data.LinkMode or "Follow"
	-- maskRefCF (the emitter's own frame) engages the per-axis link masks exactly as the emit does.
	local parentCF = LinkCF.emitParentFrame(linkMode, link, linkLocal, maskRefCF and data.LinkAxes or nil, maskRefCF)
	local useVOS = LinkCF.usesLinkSpace(linkMode, link)
	-- previewMaxSteps caps preview callers; InvertMotion caps emit (per-particle CFrame allocation).
	local INVERT_MAX_STEPS = 500
	local totalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames)
	if previewMaxSteps and totalKeyFrames > previewMaxSteps then
		totalKeyFrames = previewMaxSteps
	elseif data.InvertMotion and totalKeyFrames > INVERT_MAX_STEPS then
		totalKeyFrames = INVERT_MAX_STEPS
	end
	local stepDT = lifetime / totalKeyFrames

	local currentPosition = initialCF.Position
	local localCF = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(initialCF)
	local baseDir = baseDirection
	local emissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection
	local rotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife"
	local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = 0, 0, 0

	-- Snapshot AccelTarget pos at start; InvertMotion's cached CFrames can't track moving targets.
	local hasTargetAccel = data.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and data.AccelTarget ~= nil and data.AccelStrength ~= nil and not data.InvertMotion
	local targetWorldPos
	if hasTargetAccel then
		local t = data.AccelTarget
		-- Type dispatch matches Update.getTargetPosition (Bone live pose, Model pivot, etc.).
		if t:IsA("Bone") then targetWorldPos = t.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position
